name: Vanguard Of Armor
storyline:
The story is set in the mid-2030s, a period where global geopolitical stability has collapsed. Traditional diplomacy has failed, giving way to "Regional Containment Conflicts." The world is no longer fighting massive world wars, but rather high-intensity, localized battles over dwindling resources and strategic "Dead Zones."

The Premise: Iron Vanguard
You play as a high-tier commander within a private elite military task force known as the Iron Vanguard. Unlike traditional armies, the Vanguard is a technologically superior mobile unit equipped with the latest experimental armored vehicles.

Your mission is to deploy into contested territories—ranging from abandoned industrial complexes to desolate desert outposts—to secure "Data Cores" and strategic assets before rival factions or insurgent groups can seize them.

The Conflict: Steel vs. Intelligence
The narrative focuses on the evolution of warfare. It’s not just about firepower; it’s about the integration of AI-driven tactical networks. Throughout the campaign and multiplayer matches, you are fighting against the "Shadow Network"—an unknown entity that has hijacked global satellite systems and automated defense lines.

Key Story Pillars:
The Arms Race: You must constantly upgrade your tanks (from modernized classic MBTs to futuristic prototypes) to stay ahead of the enemy's escalating technology.

Tactical Extraction: Much of the lore revolves around "The Extraction"—the desperate push to get your squad and gathered intel out of the combat zone before being overwhelmed by enemy reinforcements.

The Human Cost: Between missions, the story touches on the pilots and engineers who keep these "Steel Beasts" running, highlighting the grit and sacrifice required to survive on a modern digital battlefield.
summary: Vanguard of Armor": An adrenaline-packed TPS tank battle game. Includes 5v5 Capture the Flag, ranked matches, and PvE modes, focusing on strategy and teamwork.
